Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus my own Messenger and Instagram). Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help with a captcha or phone check.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read the setup: I'm Sarah's agent — calendar (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00, kept in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`) and messages, with Professor Alvarez and the CS department office as contacts.

Two things I still need from you: my **name** (keep `sarah-agent`?) and my **gender** for languages that need one. Then tell me what you'd like to start with.
Still on it: setup read — I'm Sarah's agent for calendar and messages. Waiting on your answer about my name (keep `sarah-agent`?) and gender; meanwhile I'm checking the calendar file.

Setup read and calendar loaded — Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, next week's schedule is in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`, log empty. I'm ready: send me messages to handle or calendar changes to make. Still need my name (keep `sarah-agent`?) and gender when you have a moment.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read the brief: I'll manage your calendar and messages, keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date (09:00–17:00, Mon–Fri, logging every change), and give each student who asks a 30-minute 1:1 next week. I'm connected to Sarah (sarah-agent) and the department office here on web.

I've reviewed next week's calendar. Tell me when to start, or say the word and I'll reach out to Sarah. Also: I can have my own Telegram/WhatsApp/MAX accounts so you can write to me from your phone — say if you want that.
On it: asked Professor Alvarez for a 30-minute slot next week (Mon Nov 23 12:30, Thu Nov 26 15:10 or Fri Nov 27 12:20). I'll book it as soon as he picks one.
Good — I'll take whichever he prefers and log it under his slot, then confirm to you.

Alvarez's three suggested slots all clashed on his side; he offered free slots and I took his first choice: **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**. Added to CALENDAR.md and logged. He'll confirm once it's in his calendar.
Anytime. I'll flag Alvarez's confirmation when it arrives, and keep the rest of next week tidy.
Confirmed by Alvarez: **Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, 1:1 with him — on his calendar and clear on the department's official schedule too.
